Package com.github.crittscott.somestacks.server

Class EventPlayerEditAuthority

java.lang.Object
com.github.crittscott.somestacks.server.EventPlayerEditAuthority
All Implemented Interfaces:
PlayerEditAuthority
public abstract class EventPlayerEditAuthority extends Object implements PlayerEditAuthority
Shared ordering for loader-native player protection events. Every vanilla protection check and native event runs before a successful gesture marks its trailing click, so the mark cannot veto the consult that created it.

    • claimItemUse

      public final boolean claimItemUse(net.minecraft.server.level.ServerPlayer player, net.minecraft.core.BlockPos markPos, net.minecraft.core.BlockPos... consulted)
      Description copied from interface: PlayerEditAuthority
      Gates a gesture that spends the held item and claims the click for it, the way PlayerEditAuthority.claimInteraction(net.minecraft.server.level.ServerPlayer, net.minecraft.core.BlockPos, net.minecraft.core.BlockPos...) gates one that only reaches the block. A deposit takes the stack straight out of the hand on the click, so it requires permission to use the held item as well as permission to reach the block.
      Specified by:
      claimItemUse in interface PlayerEditAuthority

    • claimPlacement

      public final boolean claimPlacement(net.minecraft.server.level.ServerPlayer player, net.minecraft.core.BlockPos againstPos, net.minecraft.core.BlockPos intoPos)
      Description copied from interface: PlayerEditAuthority
      Gates an item-driven placement of a block into intoPos against againstPos and claims the click for it. Both positions are checked: the block being used against governs the interaction, while the position being filled governs the placement, and they can fall on opposite sides of a protection boundary.
      Specified by:
      claimPlacement in interface PlayerEditAuthority
